question: Are individual differences in target-state geometry systematically coupled to individual differences in perception geometry, so a target participant's OWN perception phenotype predicts their subject-specific target-state geometry WITHOUT target imagery?
distinction: O2.10 tested SHARED geometry (donor geometry transfers directly). O2.11 tests PREDICTABLE subject-specific geometry (differences coupled to perception-only differences). Positive => subject-specific != idiosyncratic under the tested representation.
global_identity_holdout: reuse 6 outer folds; 2 held-out imagery identities excluded from imagery geometry for target AND all donors; donors use only the 10 outer-training identities
vision_state: REUSE exact O2.10 certified perception-anchor state: A_s (512 x V), W_s, C_s=A_s W_s, E_s=A_s-(A_s W_s)W_s.T; do not rebuild

perception_phenotype.form: perception-only, basis-invariant, common across native voxel spaces, deterministic, parameter-free

phenotype_similarity_diagnostic: CKA(s,d)=<K_s,K_d>_F (unit-norm kernels); descriptive perception-only target-to-donor similarity for K_IN and K_OUT

donor_geometry.within: rank-matched to target r_s (O2.10 construction); Q_IN_d; G_IN_d=Q_IN_d Q_IN_d.T

barycentric_predictor.objective: w* = argmin_w ||K_s - sum_d w_d K_d||_F^2 s.t. w_d>=0, sum w_d=1 (convex barycentric)
barycentric_predictor.solver: deterministic: enumerate all 127 non-empty donor active sets; per set equality-constrained LS (KKT, float64 Moore-Penrose) with 1.T w=1; accept if w>=-1e-12; clip [-1e-12,0]->0 + renormalize; min reconstruction error; ties<=1e-12 -> fewest active donors then lexicographically smallest index set (minimal-support barycentric solution)

phenotype_coverage.no_status_gate_on_fit: poor fit => target phenotype outside donor convex hull (cohort-coverage limitation)

predicted_geometry.within: G_PRED_RAW_IN = sum_d w_IN_d G_IN_d ; top r_s eigvecs -> Q_PRED_IN
predicted_geometry.outside: G_PRED_RAW_OUT = sum_d w_OUT_d G_OUT_d ; top 2 eigvecs -> Q_PRED_OUT

target_lift: REUSE certified O2.10 lift: within via pinv(C_s), outside via pinv(E_s) + remove W_s leakage; produce B_IN_PRED/P_IN_PRED, B_OUT_PRED/P_OUT_PRED; no new transport estimator
transport_ceiling: REUSE sealed O2.10 adequacy (all 4 primary carriers adequate); do NOT rerun/redefine; O2.11 failure => predictor failure not carrier failure
target_oracle_stageB: target own full-resource 10-id geometry -> G_TARGET_IN, G_TARGET_OUT (EVALUATION REFERENCES ONLY; cannot change Stage-A predictions)
geometry_similarity: SIM_GEOM = trace(P T)/r for equal-rank projectors (0..1); SIM_IN, SIM_OUT separately

matched_null.type: perception->geometry correspondence null: keep Stage-A weights FIXED, permute donor GEOMETRY labels; G_PRED_NULL = sum_d w_d G_{pi(d)}; preserves phenotype/kernels/weights/geometry-distribution/ranks, destroys perception->geometry correspondence

effects.native: lift each geometry-permutation null through the SAME target carrier -> R_c_NULL; E_NATIVE_c = R_c_PRED - mean(R_c_NULL) (PRIMARY inferential effect)

component_predictable: PERCEPTION_PREDICTABLE iff ALL: median E_NATIVE>0; >=6/8 E_NATIVE>0; Holm reject; median clipped GEOM_RECOVERY>=0.50; >=6/8 GEOM_RECOVERY>=0.50; median clipped TRANSFER_RECOVERY>=0.50; >=6/8 TRANSFER_RECOVERY>=0.50 (BOTH geometry-level AND native-consequence required)
composite_success: PERCEPTION_PREDICTED_COMPOSITE_GEOMETRY_SUFFICIENT iff both components PERCEPTION_PREDICTABLE AND median+>=6/8 TOTAL_RECOVERY_PRED>=0.50 AND median+>=6/8 COMPOSITE_CAPACITY_FRACTION>=0.50 (no extra p-value)
o2_10_comparator: GAIN_OVER_O2_10 = R_COMP_PRED - R_COMP_XSUB_O2_10 (participant-first; descriptive; success should materially outperform O2.10 consensus)
pairwise_association: descriptive: Spearman rho of SIM_PERCEPTION(=<K_s,K_d>_F) vs SIM_GEOMETRY over 28 subject pairs, per component/ROI; NOT independent N; no pair-level p-value; LOSO operational test is primary
aggregation: participant-first: 2 held-out ids -> 6 folds -> participant metrics; N=8

roi_status.TARGET_PERCEPTION_PREDICTS_COMPOSITE_GEO: both components predictable + composite operational passes

program_status.PERCEPTION_PREDICTS_GEOMETRY_BUT_OPERATI: both ROIs both components predictable but composite fails
program_status.SUBJECT_SPECIFIC_GEOMETRY_NOT_PREDICTABL: neither primary ROI establishes useful component predictability

positive: individual differences in target-state geometry predictable from individual differences in the target's dense-perception phenotype, without target imagery calibration
target-state geometry subject-specific but not idiosyncratic under the tested representation
negative: under the tested dense-perception phenotype + deterministic perception-conditioned predictor, subject-specific target-state geometry was not recoverably predictable from target perception alone
claim_boundaries.note: substantial target PERCEPTION calibration still used

cohort_limitation: n=7 donors per LOSO prediction is extremely small for individual-difference mappings; parameter-free convex interpolation used intentionally; failure may reflect uncoupled geometries OR inadequate phenotype OR insufficient donor coverage (not distinguishable without evidence)

two_stage_seal.STAGE_A: target perception + donor perception + donor imagery geometry -> freeze kernels/weights/predicted IN+OUT fingerprints/target-native lifted bases; commit hashes; NO target imagery
two_stage_seal.STAGE_B: after Stage-A server verify: open target oracle -> GEOM_RECOVERY -> held-out imagery -> geometry-permutation null -> native effects -> 4-test Holm -> composite classification

next_gate.ZERO_TARGET_IMAGERY_COMPOSITE_GEOMETRY_P: O2.12 MINIMAL TARGET-PERCEPTION CALIBRATION FRONTIER (reduce 512-image perception burden)
next_gate.PERCEPTION_PREDICTS_GEOMETRY_BUT_OPERATI: O2.12 PREDICTION + MINIMAL IMAGERY CORRECTION (perception prior + 1-2 imagery obs correct residual)
next_gate.SUBJECT_SPECIFIC_GEOMETRY_NOT_PREDICTABL: O2.12 MINIMAL IMAGERY CALIBRATION WITH PERCEPTION-ONLY PRIOR CONTROL (can O2.9 8-trial be reduced via fixed hybrid prior) OR O2.12 SUBJECT-SPECIFIC GEOMETRY COVARIATE DIAGNOSTIC (additional non-imagery features); no high-capacity predictor from N=8
